parts.name: mattress_nem_xo_dua_120
sources: A mattress of 120 by 200 by 10 cm: its cover sewn from 4 pieces (World.Sewing.Cushion).
Mattresses of 120 and 160 by 200 cm, 5, 10 and 15 cm thick (Vạn Thành; Dunlopillo: 160 by 200 by 10 cm).
A cover of knitted ticking of polyester, 200 g/m2 (MH Chine: jacquard knitted mattress fabric; knitted tickings are 150 to 650 g/m2).
A mat of coconut coir (xơ dừa) bonded with latex, 75 kg/m3 (Mattress Mick: 50 to 100 kg/m3).
Foam of high resilience HR35, 35 kg/m3 (Onsen: 30 to 45 kg/m3 for the open cells of HR foam).
